journeys.name: b5-general-ticker-main-flow
journeys.note: 手键组训 end-to-end with the frontend payloads (list.js:122 add with SelectCable.vue Integer codeSort, handKeyTrain.js:123/208/656/610 findPage/startTrain/uploadResult/finish, teacher.js:299 socket updateTrainStatus): fixed 3-group cable so content is deterministic; teacher (sweep-admin, creator, role 1) and student hold /generalTickerPat sockets and classic /websocket sockets; ownership (207) and stale-attempt/terminal (208) probes. Clock handling: capture_started_at is pinned to 2026-10-09 00:00:00 by seed_sql only AFTER the first startTrain (that step deliberately observes whether the room start set the capture clock); fixed captureIntervals [0,3900] make speed/activeMillis/score deterministic; only serverElapsedMs, train-level validTime and generated train ids are masked (datetime strings are normalized by the sweep). Outsider b5-tk-out is seeded with INSERT IGNORE.

journeys.name: b5-general-ticker-history-reset-notify
journeys.note: Two trainings for the same student: A (never finished, create_time pinned to 2026-10-01 so findAll order and the previous-score window are deterministic) and B (start, upload, reset to attempt 1, stale attempt 208s, re-upload, finish). Checks the statistics userTendencyVO previous score (Java: isFinish=1 ORDER BY createTime), NOTIFICATION_NEW_TRAIN addressing (classic socket only in Java) while the student holds another ticker room socket, and delete closing that socket. capture_started_at is re-pinned after reset because reset restarts the capture clock.

journeys.name: b5-general-ticker-closing-window-cable
journeys.note: Fixed cable with 1 floor but messageNumber=150 (server-side contract; the UI sends pages*100): detail page counts, stop-before-start message, capture extension rule, stop while unfinished -> status 3, WS end, page 2 missing-floor 202, reset during closing, finish inside the 60 s grace window (steps run within seconds of the stop; the 5 s recovery sweep only touches end_time<=now-60s, so it cannot race), then delete closing both sockets.
